summary: Frontend regression for Fixing_Prompt.docx PART A (persistent 45/55 map on movers wizard) + PART B (pickup.line1 bug fix + draft-restore across login). All targeted fixes verified working. Desktop 1440x900: [data-testid=exp-wizard-map] present on Movers wizard Step 1 (Type), Step 2 (Pickup&Drop) and Step 3 (Items); A/B AdvancedMarkers render at pickup/drop; distance (km) + duration (min) overlay chips render 2x (once on the mobile-order compact map card, once on the desktop persistent map, both in DOM per the shell design). Mobile 390x844 on the movers wizard shows only 1 visible map — the compact card, height=160px at y=126 (above form) — the desktop persistent panel is `hidden md:block` so it collapses. Regression: /express/book/location (parcel Step1) AND /express/book/estimate (parcel Step5) both still render the persistent map on the right 55% column with the yellow Directions polyline drawn between pickup and drop (confirmed via screenshot — Directions API is in fact enabled on the key; the yellow route is visible with A/B pins). PART B verified: on a fresh guest session with a valid draft seeded to sessionStorage.baked_express_draft (pickup+drop with line1 populated, receiver, vehicle=bike, package), navigating to /express/book/estimate and clicking `exp-est-book` correctly opens the login modal and sets sessionStorage.baked_post_login='/express/book/estimate'. After page reload the draft is preserved intact (pickup.line1='Cocody Angré', drop.line1='Plateau'). AddressSelector.jsx onConfirm (lines 472-475) code-inspected: `finalized = addr && !addr.line1 && (addr.formatted_address || addr.description) ? { ...addr, line1: addr.formatted_address || addr.description } : addr` — line1 is now mirrored from formatted_address whenever Places omits a street line. ExpressWizardShell + WizardMap accept optional draft prop and fall back to useExpressBooking() when omitted (verified by /express/book/location still rendering the parcel-context-driven map without any draft prop being passed).
action_items: INFO/NON-BLOCKING: Google Maps console warnings — google.maps.DirectionsService & DirectionsRenderer marked deprecated as of Feb 25, 2026. Not scheduled for removal (12-mo notice guaranteed), but a future refactor to google.maps.routes.Route.computeRoutes is recommended. See migration guide: https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/javascript/routes/routes-js-migration

INFO: sessionStorage key for the movers draft is 'baked_express_movers_draft' (as defined in ExpressContext.jsx line 81), NOT 'baked_movers_draft' as mentioned in the review request's files_of_reference. State persistence works correctly with the actual key. Just noting for the next agent to prevent confusion.

MINOR CODE-REVIEW: The distance/duration chips render TWICE on mobile viewports briefly (both compact card DOM + hidden desktop persistent DOM). Not visible to users (persistent is display:none via `hidden md:block`) but it does mean the DirectionsService fires twice per (pickup,drop) pair — small perf cost + doubled Maps API billing per render. Consider rendering WizardMap only once and swapping its `compact` prop via a Tailwind responsive helper, or gating the desktop copy with a matchMedia guard.
critical_code_review_comments: ExpressWizardShell renders <WizardMap/> twice (once compact for mobile, once large for desktop). Both mount an APIProvider + Map + DirectionsService independently. On viewport-change (e.g. window resize crossing the md breakpoint) both instances stay in the DOM. Refactor: render WizardMap once, use CSS to change its container height, and let `compact` be derived from a `useIsMobile()` hook instead of duplicating the component tree — halves Maps API load.

MoversWizard.jsx submit() (line 414) calls openLogin('/express/movers/wizard') but this returns the user to the wizard's Step 1 (state is not preserved via URL — the step index lives in local useState). Because the movers draft is persisted to sessionStorage the pickup/drop/items ARE restored on reload, but the customer lands back on 'Type' and has to re-walk 5 steps to get back to Review. Consider persisting `step` in sessionStorage or querystring, or passing openLogin('/express/movers/wizard?step=5').

Fixing_Prompt.docx mentions Bulk Delivery needs the same 45/55 layout but /express/book/location is the shared parcel/bulk/document/business/scheduled wizard (per ExpressServices.jsx — all five service tiles route to the same /express/book/location). This is already covered by the existing parcel ExpressWizardShell. If Bulk needs a differentiated map or different draft object, that's a follow-up.

AddressSelector.jsx onConfirm fix (line 472-475) is defensive but only fires for the Autocomplete/prediction path. The `onPickSaved` path (line 417-431) constructs candidate without line1 either — but saved addresses in the DB already have a `line1` column, so `addr.line1` from a saved row would already be non-null. Recent-searches (`onPickRecent`, line 433-443) also skips line1 and is a potential future source of the same 422 if a recent-search row is missing line1. Consider mirroring formatted_address→line1 in those two callbacks too for full defense-in-depth.
Google Directions API deprecation warnings will spam the console until migrated. Cosmetic only for now.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Fast path for movers wizard: sessionStorage.setItem('baked_express_movers_draft', JSON.stringify({move_type:'house', pickup:{line1:'...',latitude,longitude,formatted_address}, drop:{...}, items:[{item_id,name,qty,base_price,weight_kg}], pickup_building:{lift,stairs,floor,parking}, drop_building:{...}, labour_movers:2})) then reload /express/movers/wizard?type=house. NOTE the actual sessionStorage key is 'baked_express_movers_draft' (not 'baked_movers_draft' as the prompt says). ExpressWizardShell renders WizardMap TWICE (mobile compact + desktop persistent, one hidden via `hidden md:block`), so `document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=exp-wizard-map]').length === 2` on every wizard step — use visible-count for assertions. Directions API IS enabled on the current key (yellow polyline visible on parcel + movers wizards); Haversine fallback path is unused in preview. Address 422 bug fix location: /app/frontend/src/components/address/AddressSelector.jsx lines 472-475.
rca of the issue: PART B root cause (pre-fix): AddressSelector.onConfirm handed the candidate object as-is to the caller (booking draft). Google Places autocomplete returns `formatted_address` but not always a discrete street `line1`. Backend Pydantic model AddressPoint requires `line1: str` — so POST /express/bookings failed with 422 `pickup.line1: Field required`. axios interceptor surfaced this as a generic toast that the UI+prompt author read as 'pickup not selected'. FIX (verified in place): onConfirm now mirrors `formatted_address || description → line1` when line1 is absent, guaranteeing the backend contract. Verified draft persistence across the mid-wizard login by: (1) inspecting sessionStorage after reload — pickup.line1 & drop.line1 intact, (2) confirming BakedContexts openLogin writes baked_post_login and loginWithToken uses window.location.href for a hard reload that re-hydrates from sessionStorage.
